posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked: I think that the Infinitor promo is amazing, flavour-wise.  Capt. Cosmic manages to reach out to his brother and convince him to change sides, but Infinitor is still harrowed by mental troubles, with manifestations that he can't control wreaking havoc?  What incredible development in his character and his relationship with his brother.  It shows a lot about the heroes as well that they accept him as an ally and do the best they can to deal with the consequences.  I didn't order the oversized villain cards because I've always felt that the regular ones did the job just fine, but that promo is making me reconsider soooo hard...

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
That's what I like about this promo both mechanic and story wise so far.   I'm sure play testers know what his flipped side does but I would guess he becomes a villain target again(or not a target at all) that lashes out at everyone on the field.     Also on the other side the heroes can't win the game I suspect as they want to save their ally and if he is still a target destroying him causes a loss.   As to how you get him flip back over I imagine there has to be some special condition involving the manifestations he can get under him from his initial side.   

I bought the oversized villain cards because I liked the direction from the art preview and I wanted to get a hold of the older promo villains in Cosmic Omnitron and Bomber Blade.
